result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_edges()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add multiple edges to the graph in a single call. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L1119-L1270){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_edges( edges, rel=None, weight=None, auto_create_nodes=False, **shared_attrs, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A bulk version of `add_edge()` that accepts a list of `(source, target)` pairs and applies shared attributes to all of them. Individual edges can override shared attributes by passing a third element as a dict in the tuple. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [edges]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Edge definitions to add. Each element can be: - A tuple of `(source, target)` with shared attributes applied. - A tuple of `(source, target, attrs_dict)` to override shared attributes for that edge. [rel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional relationship type applied to every edge (unless overridden per-edge). [weight]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional weight applied to every edge (unless overridden per-edge). [auto_create_nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, automatically create nodes that don't exist yet. If `False` (default), all referenced nodes must already exist. [**shared_attrs]{.doc-parameter-name} : Attributes applied to every edge (unless overridden per-edge). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Returns self to enable method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Add several edges at once: ::: {#806b0528 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_nodes(['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']) .add_edges([('A', 'B'), ('B', 'C'), ('C', 'D')]) ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` Number of nodes : 4 Number of edges : 3 Directed : True Density : 0.25 Average degree (min, max) : 1.50 (1, 2) Strongly connected : False Weakly connected : True Number of strongly connected components : 4 Number of weakly connected components : 1 ``` ::: ::: Shared relationship type: ::: {#901d4e0f .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_nodes(['Alice', 'Bob', 'Carol']) .add_edges( [('Alice', 'Bob'), ('Bob', 'Carol')], rel='follows' ) ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 2 Directed : True Density : 0.33 Average degree (min, max) : 1.33 (1, 2) Strongly connected : False Weakly connected : True Number of strongly connected components : 3 Number of weakly connected components : 1 ``` ::: ::: Per-edge overrides via a third tuple element: ::: {#69b4e0ae .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True, weighted=True) .add_nodes(['A', 'B', 'C']) .add_edges( [ ('A', 'B'), ('A', 'C', {'weight': 2.0, 'rel': 'strong'}), ], rel='weak', weight=1.0 ) ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 2 Directed : True Density : 0.33 Average degree (min, max) : 1.33 (1, 2) Strongly connected : False Weakly connected : True Number of strongly connected components : 3 Number of weakly connected components : 1 ``` ::: ::: Build a complete graph using `auto_create_nodes`: ::: {#83f5e0c7 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_edges( [ ('Alice', 'Bob'), ('Bob', 'Carol'), ('Carol', 'Alice'), ], rel='knows', auto_create_nodes=True ) ) graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 3 Directed : True Density : 0.50 Average degree (min, max) : 2.00 (2, 2) Strongly connected : True Weakly connected : True Number of strongly connected components : 1 Number of weakly connected components : 1 ``` ::: :::
